notice: Planning guidance, not assigned tasks, official rules, eligibility approval or medical clearance. Local organizers and authorized staff approve event requirements. Choosing a guide never changes your account role or permissions.

globalSetup.title: Location, language and time
items: Choose country/region, preferred language and venue time zone explicitly.
Store event instants with the venue IANA time zone; display local and travel times clearly.
Support date/time formats, translations, long names and right-to-left interfaces without changing identity.

globalSetup.title: Sport and competition identity
items: Choose sport, discipline, format, team/individual entry and current season.
Allow multiple sports/teams and a custom sport; distinguish soccer from American football and hockey disciplines.
Attach the actual local federation/league, rule edition and authorized organizer rather than a universal rule assumption.

globalSetup.title: Units and categories
items: Choose metric/imperial display and retain the original unit for measurements/results.
Record event-authorized categories only when applicable; never infer eligibility, disability classification or participation from a profile.
Support times, distances, sets, judged scores, attempts, brackets and rankings; not every sport is a two-team points game.

globalSetup.title: People and authority
items: Verify the account, team membership and separately approved staff/guardian relationships.
Allow multiple approved team responsibilities and name backups; self-selected interests grant no privileges.
Keep public fans, visiting teams, volunteers and student media outside private roster, academic and care access.

globalSetup.title: Access and safeguarding
items: Offer accessible transport, venue, communication and equipment-support requests through private channels.
Use age-appropriate guardian and supervision workflows under local organizational policy.
Configure local emergency contacts and qualified venue-specific response plans; do not hardcode one worldwide emergency number.

globalSetup.title: Travel and connectivity
items: Confirm domestic/international travel documents and consent through authorized organizers when applicable.
Show dated offline itinerary snapshots, pending changes and reliable sign-out/account separation.
Resolve schedule changes, daylight-saving differences and overlapping events before notifying affected people.

universalAthlete.title: Before the event
items: Confirm the correct event, entry, location, reporting time and organizer instructions.
Review your assigned role, coach-approved preparation and any required authorized reviews.
Confirm travel, school/work arrangements and who to contact if plans change.

universalAthlete.title: Pack and travel
items: Check your sport-specific approved kit, spare items and labeled personal belongings.
Confirm meals/hydration arrangements and any individual plan with the appropriate staff.
Confirm meeting point, transport, arrival and the return/release arrangement.

universalAthlete.title: At the venue
items: Check in through the organizer process and confirm schedule changes.
Attend assigned equipment/credential checks and supervised warm-up.
Know your coach/support contacts and the venue briefing; report concerns to appropriate staff.

universalAthlete.title: After the event
items: Follow staff-directed check-out, return travel and guardian release where applicable.
Return issued equipment and report missing or damaged items.
Review confirmed results and coach feedback; keep private support information out of public posts.
